text:
carla: first-day question . i'm on M2 mac (Ventura) and also using a WSL Ubuntu VM to mirror infra. followed the quickstart but blocked on a couple of things: asdf plugin installs fail with permission errors under /opt/homebrew, ruby gems fail linking to openssl, and we have a sops+age encrypted secrets file i don't have a key for. also wondering where to stash REDWOOD_API_KEY locally (direnv? keychain?). who's the right person and any quick fixes?

matt: welcome! short answers: direnv + per-user env file for API keys; brew prefix perms are usually a fixable thing; sops/age keys are requested from infra; openssl flags for mac. details: 1) Homebrew perms: if you see EACCES when writing to /opt/homebrew, run `sudo chown -R $(whoami) /opt/homebrew` (only if you installed brew yourself) or reinstall brew under your user. Avoid `sudo brew`.

matt: 2) asdf plugin errors: sometimes the plugin clones into ~/.asdf/plugins and fails because asdf was installed via brew but the plugin dir is root-owned. check `ls -ld $(brew --prefix asdf)/..` and ensure your user owns `~/.asdf` or `$(brew --prefix asdf)/libexec`. If you installed asdf via brew, prefer `brew reinstall asdf` and then `mkdir -p ~/.asdf/plugins && chown -R $(whoami) ~/.asdf`.

matt: 3) OpenSSL / Ruby on Apple silicon: brew install openssl@3 pkg-config then before any ruby/gem compile set:
```
export LDFLAGS="-L$(brew --prefix openssl@3)/lib"
export CPPFLAGS="-I$(brew --prefix openssl@3)/include"
export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="$(brew --prefix openssl@3)/lib/pkgconfig"
```
Then `asdf install ruby <version>` or `gem install ...` should link properly.

matt: 4) sops/age: infra manages the age key. open the onboarding form and request "sops age key" for local dev. Until then, mock `secrets.local.json` and keep it gitignored. We recommend storing short-lived tokens in the macOS keychain and using direnv to expose them to shells via `direnv reload`. Example local path we use: `~/.config/redwood/env.local` (gitignored) with `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-local-...`

carla: thanks! small extra: my fish shell doesn't load asdf with the default zsh snippets. any fish tips?

matt: for fish add `source (brew --prefix asdf)/libexec/asdf.fish` to `~/.config/fish/config.fish` or clone asdf and `source $HOME/.asdf/asdf.fish`. Also ensure `direnv` fish hook is enabled: `direnv hook fish` in config.

carla: WSL note : on Ubuntu i hit `node-gyp` errors missing python and pkg-config.

matt: on WSL run `sudo apt install -y build-essential python3 pkg-config libssl-dev zlib1g-dev libffi-dev`. Also `rustup` if npm modules use Rust. Avoid mixing nvm with asdf shims. If you had nvm before, remove nvm lines from your rc or put asdf first in PATH.

ops-bot: created access ticket INF-5678 to provision sops age key and add carla to onboarding dotfiles team.

carla: perfect. i'll try the chown on /opt/homebrew, set openssl env flags, add direnv+env.local, and request the sops key. i'll post back if anything else breaks :thumbsup:
